goal: Add a cart module that stores money as integer cents and rejects negative quantities
required_behavior: The cart stores money as integer cents

acceptance_criteria.criterion: src/cart.js stores item prices as integer cents
Adding an item with a negative quantity is rejected

verification_plan: Add items to a cart and check the stored totals are integers
Add an item with quantity -1 and check it is rejected

requirements.quote: stores money asinteger cents and rejects negative quantities

proposed_defaults.text: Use 16-bit integers for storing monetary values
proposed_defaults.reason: The request does not say how large amounts can be

proposed_defaults.text: Return 'Invalid input' error message for negative values
proposed_defaults.reason: The request does not name the error
